lines.text: Albert Einstein was born 14 March 1879 in Ulm, Germany.
In 1921, Prof. Albert Einstein was at the meeting of the National Academy of Sciences at the Smithsonian Institution.
On Dec. 31, 1930, Einstein and Mrs. Einstein were with a reception committee at San Diego, Calif.
In 1930, Albert Einstein and Elsa Einstein arrived in San Diego on the Belgenland.
In 1933 Albert Einstein renounced his German citizenship.
Albert Einstein immigrated to the United States.
Albert Einstein had a home study at 112 Mercer Street, Princeton, New Jersey.
112 Mercer Street remained Albert Einstein's home until his death in 1955.
Albert Einstein was working as a consultant to the United States Government during World War II.
Albert Einstein was photographed receiving from Judge Phillip Forman his certificate of American citizenship.
The Declaration of Intention for Albert Einstein is from 15 January 1936.
Albert Einstein died on April 18, 1955 at Princeton, New Jersey.
